scope: Built local isolated QA API; no real account mutation, external model request or live outage injection.

focused_browser.command: INHERIA_FRONTEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8021 npx playwright test tests/handover-readiness.spec.ts tests/transfer-budget.spec.ts tests/source-permissions.spec.ts --reporter=list,junit

cases.name: incomplete handover explains blockers before closure and links to recovery work
changed evidence and readiness failures stop closure; refresh recovers the panel
request limits show cooldown and do not trigger immediate automatic retries
public guide explains the submitted improvements in both themes and mobile layouts
manual access refresh updates externally changed membership and source permissions
source permission editor preserves current readers and limits incoming evidence
idle workspace does not poll; active work refreshes results once and stops
failed background work refreshes dependent state and stops polling

separate_full_journey.result: Passed fresh source reconstruction through closure and cross-page inspection in 3.4 minutes.
separate_full_journey.initial_failure: Accelerated post-closure navigation reached the shared-IP rate limit and timed out. Client cooldown handling and paced harness were corrected; server limit was preserved.

limits: Targeted changed/unavailable/rate-limit states use browser response fixtures; they are not deliberately injected live outages.
Bounded automated axe checks do not establish a complete accessibility audit or independent human usability study.
No awarded score, participant contribution, source authenticity or cloud operational competence is certified.
PDF generation is deferred at the leader request.
